text.en:
Passively decreases Zoom by #Zoom.

Decreasing Zoom has the following effects in ADS:
• Decreased Magnification
• Decreased Aim Assist Falloff Distance
• Increased <title Absolute Recoil [absRecoil] />
• Widened Accuracy and Aim Assist Cones (size stays the same on-screen)

title absRecoil (
Absolute Recoil represents how closely grouped your shots will be in the physical environment to an observer. The recoil you experience on-screen remains identical but if you're less zoomed-in, your bullets will end up being grouped farther apart.
)

//Mod used for low Zoom weapon archetypes
var Zoom = 1
